title: Brake Service Warranties Price Schedule: Pads, Labor, Hardware, Rotors and Fluid
content:
**All prices in US dollars.** This schedule lists the selling prices of every line of Brake Service Warranties. Pad, labor, hardware and package prices are per axle; rotor prices are per rotor.

## Schedule A — pads, labor, hardware and package

| Brake service line | Pad set, per axle | Pad replacement labor, per axle | Hardware kit included | Hardware kit, per axle | Rotors part of the job price | Package price, per axle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 79.99 | 129.99 | No | 19.99 | No | 0.00 |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 109.99 | 129.99 | Yes | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 139.99 | 139.99 | Yes | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 169.99 | 139.99 | Yes | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 169.99 | 149.99 | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | 449.99 |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 149.99 | 159.99 | Yes | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |

## Schedule B — rotor work and fluid exchange

| Brake service line | Resurface one rotor | One new rotor installed | Brake fluid exchange added to the job |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 24.99 | 69.99 | 99.99 |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 24.99 | 79.99 | 99.99 |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 24.99 | 89.99 | 99.99 |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 24.99 | 89.99 | 99.99 |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 29.99 | 109.99 | 109.99 |

## Notes to the schedules

1. *Hardware kit.* "Hardware kit included" states whether new clips and shims come with the job. The hardware kit price is the price of a kit when it is not included; on a line that includes the kit the price column reads 0.00.
2. *Package price.* The package price per axle is the price of the job when rotors are part of the job price. A package price of 0.00 means the line is not sold as a package. Only the Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty carries a package price, 449.99 per axle, and only that line shows rotors as part of the job price.
3. *Rotor prices.* The resurfacing price is for one rotor; the new-rotor price is for one rotor installed.
4. *Brake fluid exchange.* The fluid exchange price is the price of a brake fluid exchange added to a brake job on that line.

## Reading the schedules

- On the Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty, the kit is not included and is priced at 19.99 per axle; every other line includes it, so no separate kit price applies.
- Resurfacing one rotor is priced the same, 24.99, on the Value, Standard, Ceramic and Premium Ceramic lines; the Severe-Duty line prices it at 29.99.
- The Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty has the highest new-rotor price (109.99 per rotor) and fluid exchange price (109.99) of the itemized lines.
